text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Delusional Disorder, Persecutory Type.

The patient's core symptoms involve fixed, false beliefs of persecution and mind control without the prominent hallucinations or disorganized behavior seen in schizophrenia, alongside a recent functional decline.
